{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction Index", "construction": "Derived from employee review platforms like Glassdoor, and labor-market data from Bureau of Labor Statistics. The index would be built using a mix of job satisfaction, wage rates, and company ratings.", "rationale": "Firms with high workforce satisfaction tend to have higher productivity, leading to better performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Environmental Impact Score", "construction": "Calculate the Environmental Impact Score using publicly available pollution data and company filings about environmental practices.", "rationale": "Companies with low environmental impact might be more sustainable in long run and could face fewer regulatory penalties.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Supply Chain Resilience", "construction": "Measured by diversification and geographic spread of a company's suppliers, as well as the company's past ability to manage supply shocks.", "rationale": "Companies with more resilient supply chains are more robust to shocks, and therefore less risky.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Cybersecurity Investment", "construction": "From annual reports and other filings, measure a firm's investment in cybersecurity infrastructure and personnel.", "rationale": "Given the increasing importance of digital assets, firms that invest in cybersecurity may be better positioned to protect those assets and avoid costly breaches.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Index", "construction": "Use company reports and third party audits to measure a company's commitment to CSR.", "rationale": "Companies with high CSR could be better positioned to manage social risks and attract socially-conscious customers and investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Product Diversity", "construction": "Measure the number of distinct product lines a company has.", "rationale": "Companies with a diverse range of products might be less susceptible to industry-specific shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Customer Concentration", "construction": "Calculated as the revenue percentage coming from the company's largest customer.", "rationale": "High customer concentration could make a firm more vulnerable to customer-specific shocks.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Management Tenure", "construction": "Average tenure of the management team, derived from company reports.", "rationale": "Long-tenured management could indicate stability, institutional knowledge, and long-term strategic execution.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Patent Portfolio", "construction": "Number and citation impact of patents held by the company, derived from the US Patent and Trademark Office.", "rationale": "A strong patent portfolio can indicate a firm's innovation capacity and its ability to generate future cash flows.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Internet Presence", "construction": "Measure company's web traffic, social media followers, and online brand mentions.", "rationale": "Companies with a strong internet presence may have greater brand visibility and customer engagement, leading to higher sales.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
